+"""Standalone helper for attaching a parameter to a command or callback.
+
+This mirrors the behavior of ``click.decorators._param_memo`` but inserts
+the parameter at the front instead of appending it. It does not import
+Click, so the command class to check against is passed in explicitly.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+
+def prepend_parameter(
+    Command: type[t.Any], f: t.Callable[..., t.Any], param: t.Any
+) -> None:
+    """Insert ``param`` at index zero of the parameters for ``f``.
+
+    If ``f`` is an instance of ``Command``, the parameter is inserted into
+    ``f.params``. Otherwise it is inserted into ``f.__click_params__``,
+    which is created as an empty list if it does not exist yet.
+
+    :param Command: The command class used for the ``isinstance`` check.
+    :param f: A constructed command or a callback function.
+    :param param: The parameter to insert.
+    """
+    if isinstance(f, Command):
+        f.params.insert(0, param)
+    else:
+        if not hasattr(f, "__click_params__"):
+            f.__click_params__ = []  # type: ignore
+
+        f.__click_params__.insert(0, param)  # type: ignore

+++ b/tests/test_standalone_prepend_parameter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+
+_PATH = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_prepend_parameter.py"
+
+
+def _load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("standalone_prepend_parameter", _PATH)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+prepend_parameter = _load().prepend_parameter
+
+
+def test_does_not_import_click():
+    tree = ast.parse(_PATH.read_text())
+    names = set()
+
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            names.update(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            names.add(node.module)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            assert node.id != "_param_memo"
+
+    assert not any(n == "click" or n.startswith("click.") for n in names)
+
+
+def test_loads_without_click(monkeypatch):
+    for name in list(sys.modules):
+        if name == "click" or name.startswith("click."):
+            monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, name, None)
+    assert callable(_load().prepend_parameter)
+
+
+def test_command_prepends():
+    first = click.Option(["--a"])
+    cmd = click.Command("cmd", params=[first])
+    second = click.Option(["--b"])
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, cmd, second)
+    assert cmd.params == [second, first]
+
+
+def test_command_empty_params():
+    cmd = click.Command("cmd")
+    param = click.Argument(["x"])
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, cmd, param)
+    assert cmd.params == [param]
+
+
+def test_command_does_not_get_click_params():
+    cmd = click.Command("cmd")
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, cmd, click.Argument(["x"]))
+    assert not hasattr(cmd, "__click_params__")
+
+
+def test_callback_creates_list():
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    param = click.Option(["--a"])
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, f, param)
+    assert f.__click_params__ == [param]
+
+
+def test_callback_prepends_to_existing():
+    def f():
+        pass
+
+    existing = []
+    f.__click_params__ = existing
+    a, b = click.Option(["--a"]), click.Option(["--b"])
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, f, a)
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, f, b)
+    assert f.__click_params__ is existing
+    assert existing == [b, a]
+
+
+def test_injected_command_class():
+    class Fake:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.params = ["old"]
+
+    obj = Fake()
+    prepend_parameter(Fake, obj, "new")
+    assert obj.params == ["new", "old"]
+
+
+def test_command_subclass_uses_params():
+    cmd = click.Group("grp")
+    param = click.Option(["--a"])
+    prepend_parameter(click.Command, cmd, param)
+    assert cmd.params == [param]
+
+
+def test_non_command_without_attributes_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        prepend_parameter(click.Command, object(), click.Option(["--a"]))
+
+
+def test_command_with_bad_params_raises():
+    cmd = click.Command("cmd")
+    cmd.params = None
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        prepend_parameter(click.Command, cmd, click.Option(["--a"]))
+
+
+def test_matches_reference_order_reversed():
+    from click.decorators import _param_memo
+
+    def ref():
+        pass
+
+    def new():
+        pass
+
+    params = [click.Option([f"--p{i}"]) for i in range(3)]
+    for p in params:
+        _param_memo(ref, p)
+        prepend_parameter(click.Command, new, p)
+    assert new.__click_params__ == list(reversed(ref.__click_params__))
notes:
Copied _param_memo's two-branch control flow into a Click-free module with Command injected as the isinstance target, changing append to insert(0, ...). Tests load the module by file path and verify both branches, list creation, error cases, no click imports, and reversed order vs the reference.
